data.name: Driti
data.gender_notes: Driti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Driti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhriti', which means firm, unyielding, truth. In Hindu mythology, Driti is the goddess of firmness, stability and unwavering determination. She is often depicted as the consort of the god Dharma, the embodiment of righteousness and moral principles. The name Driti carries the meaning “Firm, unyielding, truth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Driti usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, unyielding, truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and unwavering determination needed to navigate through life's challenges.
data.etymology: Driti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, unyielding, truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Driti total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
